summary: Philips is updating instructions for an ultrasound system after reporting eight serious injuries and four deaths, the Food and Drug Administration said Friday. The FDA, which published an early alert about Philips’ actions, said the software issue can delay the use of the portable Lumify diagnostic ultrasound system. Philips wrote to customers about the issue last month, recommending actions to mitigate the risks while it develops a software update to fix the problem.
